spans.s: अच्युत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Firm; 2. that which does not give way; 3. permanent, imperishable.
अच्युत (II) m. 1. A name of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa; 2. one who is firm and does not give way to passion, गच्छाम्यच्युतदर्शनेन भवतः किं तॄप्तिरुत्पद्यते K.Pr.v., where अच्युत is used in both the senses.

अच्युत-आवास m. the sacred fig tree.
